Webster Bank increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 411.53% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Webster Bank bought 19,420 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 24,139 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.52M, up from 4,719 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Webster Bank who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $59.55 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 3.90% or $3.33 during the last trading session, reaching $81.98. About 6.89M shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
